source.title: More Moondragon Scales
source.description: We still need more Moondragon Scales to reverse the Nightmare Incursions. Travel through the Emerald Portal in Dream Bough and bring me back some.
source.objective: Gather 10 Moondragon Scales in the Feralas Nightmare Incursions and return to Field Captain Arunnel.
source.completion: Well done! Thank you. Your services will be remembered.
